'\u003e'\n                             : limit == fast ? '='\n                                             : '\u003c'),\n                            fast);\n\n    // Restart if fast moving average is greater than (or equal to) the limit\n    return (limit \u003c= fast);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","usageMetadata":{"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5987,"modality":"TEXT"}],"promptTokenCount":5987,"thoughtsTokenCount":7196,"candidatesTokenCount":645,"totalTokenCount":13828},"responseId":"MK-KaeTyIJyB_PUPwZjkkAo"}}
